clips.title: The story
paras: Ships crowd Ratchet's docks on the eastern coast of the Barrens. The Steamwheedle Cartel runs this neutral port, linking central Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms by sea.

Ratchet gives shelter to anyone who can pay, on the dry coast between Durotar and Dustwallow Marsh. After the Third War, chief engineer Gazlowe founded the port, drawing smugglers, exiles, and daring traders to Kalimdor's frontier. The Steamwheedle Cartel runs the town, which keeps strict neutrality between the Horde and the Alliance. Ships such as The Maiden's Fancy cross the Great Sea to Booty Bay with goods, mercenaries, and raw materials. Ratchet Bruisers watch the docks and beat anyone who starts a fight and disrupts trade.

Ratchet's docks, taverns, and workshops serve a town with dealings beyond trade. A secluded tower overlooks the harbor from the hills, where warlocks including Strahad Farsan and Menara Voidrender gather. While townsfolk and sailors tend to cargo and goblin engineering, the warlocks commune with demonic forces without interference. The Steamwheedle Cartel does not enforce the moral restrictions found in traditional faction capitals.
